# Jeremy Fontenot Portfolio Repository

This repository contains the source files, assets, and deployment configuration for [jeremyfontenot.online](https://jeremyfontenot.online).

The site presents my IT support, systems administration, Microsoft 365, home lab, automation, and troubleshooting experience through project case studies and evidence-backed documentation.

## Repository Contents

- Static HTML pages for the public portfolio
- Shared CSS, JavaScript, images, and branding assets
- Project and technical case-study pages
- Home Lab and Microsoft 365 documentation
- Public-safe evidence and supporting artifacts
- GitHub Actions workflows for validation and deployment
- Sitemap, SEO metadata, and accessibility support files

## Site Maintenance Guidelines

- Keep content clear, accurate, and relevant to IT hiring managers.
- Use plain language and avoid unsupported claims.
- Keep personal, client, employer, and sensitive infrastructure data private.
- Maintain consistent navigation, spacing, typography, and card alignment.
- Confirm pages work on desktop and mobile layouts.
- Check HTML, accessibility, links, and SEO before publishing.
- Remove unused files, workflows, and stale references.
- Keep routine portfolio updates simple and easy to maintain.

## Deployment

Changes merged into the `main` branch are published through the repository’s GitHub Pages deployment workflow.

Public site: [jeremyfontenot.online](https://jeremyfontenot.online)
